name: know-your-code
description: Know Your Code: a browser workspace that teaches students their own JS/TS repositories.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w client && playwright test --project=deterministic
scripts.test:live: npm run build && LIVE=1 playwright test --project=live
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
